title: In ComfyUI, create a Seedance 2.0 reference “map” by blending DepthAnything V2…
content:
In ComfyUI, create a Seedance 2.0 reference “map” by blending DepthAnything V2 depth with DWPose (body+hand+face) pose, then feed that map into Seedance 2.0 to get multiple restyles while keeping motion/consistency.

ComfyUI node recipe for the Seedance 2.0 reference map: Load Video (Upload) with select_every_nth=1 → DepthAnything V2 (model depth_anything_v2_vitl_fp32) → DWPose Estimator with body+hand+face ON (yolox_l + dw-ll_ucoco_384) → Image Blend (depth as base, pose as layer) → Video Combine (h264 mp4); use the resulting mp4 as Seedance 2.0 reference.
